description: This file defines the Search class with static methods for case-sensitive and case-insensitive string search within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: Provides static methods for performing case-sensitive and case-insensitive string searches within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: sensitive
methods.description: Performs a case-sensitive search for a string or array of strings within another string or array of strings, returning the position or error.

methods.name: insensitive
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search for a string or array of strings within another string or array of strings, returning the position or error.
